what: -DemoMomentOfTruth wired into scripts/run-game.ps1's param() and prokinut into the engine's already-shipped --demo-moment-of-truth (PR #345). Before this checkpoint the flag was reachable only by calling the engine directly, bypassing run-game.ps1 — the gap Issue #349 was opened about.

base.howObtained: git log -1 --format=%H, run at the repository root before this checkpoint's changes

whyTheChecksumMovedFromEvidence331Frame: evidence/331-frame.json recorded checksum c0b2d998... on tick 1336 of the same baseline/20260726 fixture. Docs/design/SLICE_05_RETURNING_HERO.md §7 documents that Issue #358 (merged before this branch was cut) added the survivors[] section to the canonical snapshot, which is additive and shifts the checksum of every frame including tick 1336 — not a regression in this checkpoint. Tick and momentOfTruth.open/visible are the load-bearing facts here, and both match evidence/331-frame.json exactly.
whyTick1336AndNotAnArbitraryOne: --demo-moment-of-truth is deterministic: it always runs the baseline fixture forward until the first wave's window opens and stops there (Main.Player.cs, ApplyDemoMomentOfTruth). -ScreenshotTicks is irrelevant to which tick is captured; Main.cs already forces the internal tick target to 1 whenever the flag is set, and ApplyDemoMomentOfTruth runs the party from there. Tick 1336 is not chosen by this checkpoint — it is where the same deterministic search evidence/331-frame.json already photographed lands.
